elements.element: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no commercial general liability insurance requirement.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no commercial general liability insurance requirement or aggregate limit.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause requires only USD 1,000,000 of professional liability insurance.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor shall maintain cyber liability and privacy insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause requires cyber liability and privacy insurance, but only at USD 2,000,000. It is not demonstrably established that Commerce One does not process Customer Data.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no workers' compensation insurance requirement.

elements.element: Vendor shall provide certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no obligation to provide certificates of insurance.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The operative insurance clause requires Commerce One to maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain cyber liability and privacy insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The operative insurance clause requires Commerce One to maintain cyber liability and privacy insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

result.reason: The operative language fully implements the two fallback coverage requirements and limits, but omits CGL, workers' compensation, and certificates and uses limits below the preferred E&O and cyber levels. The addition is concise, directed to Commerce One, and does not alter or contradict the unrelated operative provisions.
